title:
One world.
Too many hands.
narration: One world. Everyone wants the keyboard. This is Control: a shared aquarium where each person's strange idea becomes the next player's starting point.

title:
One turn.
One command.
narration: Add a shark. Build a shelter. Reverse gravity. Control is the product: buy a keyboard turn, run one command, and pass the changed world to the next player.

title:
Connect.
Claim. Create.
narration: Connect your wallet on Base Sepolia and sign in. Claim 1,500 free test credits. Your balance and daily limits follow your wallet when you reconnect.

title:
Your turn
feeds the pool.
narration: Public turns cost 10 credits. Whale turns cost fifty. 80% funds the shared reward pool; 20% goes to the developer. Confirm payment, then execution, with no second credit charge.

title:
A real run.
A real receipt.
narration: Our completed testnet run started with 1,440 credits. Adding a fish and exploding one cost 20. The random reward was 30, leaving 1,450. 16 credits went to the pool; 4 to the developer.

title:
Bigger fish.
Shared rules.
narration: Add a fish or treasure to unlock a reward command. Explode a shared fish or open a chest. 60% of base rolls are empty; rewards are capped by the pool.

title:
Pull the world
into the void.
narration: A black hole uses one paid turn. It rolls for the quoted fish and treasure, swallows the entire world, and starts a new round. Inhabitants return gradually. Both aquariums receive up to 300 fresh pool credits from finite treasury reserves.

title:
Build first.
Discover next.
narration: Each wallet can buy 20 turns, 5 reward commands, and one black hole per rolling day. Each discovery consumes a contribution. Wallet limits alone do not stop someone using multiple wallets.

title:
Inspect
the mechanism.
narration: Payments, fee splitting and payouts settle on Base Sepolia. The server chooses random results. Commitments show that paid outcomes were not changed; they do not prove independently fair randomness. The rules are published.

title:
What would
you change?
narration: Try Control. Inherit the world. Leave it a little stranger. Test credits and stock-inspired souvenirs have no cash value.
